author: Build and Conquer Battle News #🚨｜breaking-news
content:
@🚨 Breaking Pings 
After a lot of thought, I’ve made the difficult decision to disband the Greater American Empire as a faction in GAE will still exist in game, but we’re ending faction operations for now. I have personal responsibilities that need my attention, and I can’t give GAE the time it deserves.

I hope to reopen GAE someday when I have the time to lead it again. Until then, thank you.

goodbye greater american empire.

content:
@🚨 Breaking Pings 

# BREAKING: Redvoid Guard and TIC Merge

Redvoid Guard and The Inner Circle (TIC) have merged, TIC member adri confirmed to BCBN.

According to the 5V Allied Powers, the merger means 5V and its allies will now be facing TIC, Black Aurum and their allies. It is not yet clear whether a formal war has been declared.

More information will follow.

**Journalists:** @Pampelasche (ARMAT)
